content.title: Bessent Says Deutsche Bank CEO Called Him to Disavow Analyst Note
content.summary: Deutsche Bank Chief Executive Christian Sewing disavowed an analyst's suggestion that Europe could dump Treasurys over the U.S. stance on Greenland, according to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.  In a weekend note, Deutsche Bank’s head of foreign-exchange research, George Saravelos, said Europe's $8 trillion of U.S. stocks and bonds could give the European Union some leverage over the U.S.  Bessent said Tuesday that such a move would defy logic and wasn’t being talked about by European governments.
